text:
Asha: quick design review of Error Analytics > Trace viewer drilldown. focus: filter chips, stacktrace badges, export copy, and keyboard a11y. mock in Figma: https://figma.com/file/zzz

Marco: main visual problem is chip overflow on narrow panes. suggestion: show up to 4 chips, then a "+N" summary chip that opens a popover listing hidden filters with checkboxes and actions (copy link, remove). keep correlation-id pinned left.

Samir: agree keep correlation-id visible. important that export uses current filters. API should accept filters array + include_correlation flag. i'll confirm API shape. also: in the popover let users copy trace link with ?corr=xxx param.

Jade: accessibility: treat chip group as a single tab stop with roving tabindex inside (role=toolbar). ensure chip labels read as "Filter: <type> equals <value>" for screen readers. announce filter changes with aria-live=polite. check color contrast for chip states.

Luis: export label should be explicit: "Export filtered results (CSV)". prefer this in the kebab menu; show a compact inline export only when filters active.

Asha: decision: visible chips up to 4, pinned correlation-id, summary +N opens popover. export CTA text: "Export filtered results (CSV)".

Marco: layout notes: +N needs hover tooltip "Show hidden filters" and clear focus ring. mobile: summary opens bottom sheet. add tiny tag on stacktraces when correlation id present next to timestamp for quick scanning.

Jade: add aria-describedby to export modal describing record count and active filters for screen reader clarity. popover items must have clear keyboard order.

design-bot: snapshot saved: "error-analytics/filter-row-updates" (v2).

Asha: next steps: Marco updates mocks with roving tabindex and +N; Jade provides exact SR copy; Samir confirms API; Luis finalizes CTA placement. i'll open a copy PR after mocks are updated. Thanks! :thumbsup:
